contact.basis: Original survey height of the first centerline abutment.

attribution: Lands Department, Hong Kong SAR Government
method: Unmodified source sample crop and bilinear interpolation to local meter coordinates. Original ArcInfo grid, transformed through Hong Kong 1980 Grid.
limitations: The published 5 m grid includes some above-ground structures and is approximate at local scale. It has no surveyed channel bathymetry.
